verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt served with HTTP 200 at the Visa Acceptance Developer Center, which hosts the Intelligent Commerce docs. The Agent Toolkit docs are also published as raw .md pages, giving agents a machine-readable docs surface they can be pointed at directly. Missing for 10: evidence that the llms.txt content specifically indexes the Intelligent Commerce and TAP docs (the probe excerpt is truncated), no equivalent llms.txt on developer.visa.com, and no hands-on report of an agent successfully consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://developer.visaacceptance.com/llms.txt # VisaAcceptance Developer Center
The specialized tools in the toolkit are designed to enable your AI agents to utilize the Pay by Link and Invoicing APIs.
